tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /dpal yang dag pa mar me dgu pa'i sgrub thabs rim pa gsal ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru shrī he ru ka ya/chos dbyings 'od gsal bde chen longs spyo
༄༅/ /dpal yang dag pa mar me dgu pa'i sgrub thabs rim pa gsal ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru shrī he ru ka ya/chos dbyings 'od gsal bde chen longs spyo

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal yang dag pa mar me dgu pa'i sgrub thabs rim pa gsal ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī he ru ka ya/ chos dbyings 'od gsal bde chen longs spyod rdzogs/ /grub pa mchog gi 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /rjes 'dzin rdo rje bzhi ldan bla ma la/ /snying nas thal sbyar gus pas yid kyi 'dud/ /rab brjid dbang sngon mdog mtshungs brjid pa'i sku/ /srid gsum gyis gnon khams gsum 'gengs pa'i gtso/ /rigs drug don mdzad phyag drug yal gas mdzes/ /bdud bzhi bar gcod zhabs bzhi ldan la 'dud/ /de mnyes byed pa'i lam rim zab mo'i nang / /yang dag me dgu sgrub pa'i thabs kyi mchog /rje btsun bla ma'i gsung rab la brten nas/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa gsal bar bri/ /de la 'dir yang dag zla gam dgu pa'i nyams len rim pa la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po/ gnas khang yid du 'ong ba'i sa ji ltar rigs pa cig tu/ dpal chen po nyid kyi bris sku dgram pa'i mdun stegs kyi steng du/ gtor ma zlum po stod sum gnyis la dbal btod pa'i tshan lnga'am gcig gam/ de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang / thod pa la sogs pa'i snod gtsang ba gnyis su sman raka ste/ gtor ma'i g.yas su chang la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa sman phud dang / g.yon du khrag gtsang ma'am/ chang la khrag dmar btab pa'i rak+ta/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ ḍā ma ru/ rnga chung la sogs pa'i rol mo'i bye brag rnams 'dus byas la/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag

rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la༞ nyi shu rtsa gcig rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum brten pa'i zhing gyur la/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyi rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rang / /dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dgos pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo/ /tshe rabs bsgrangs pa'i las rnams kun/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ /sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal dag dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing / /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ phyi nang snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang skad cig gis dpal he ru ka zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ yum khro mo dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ sa ma sa satwaṃ/ badz+ra añja li hūm̐/ badz+ra ban+dha badz+ra añja li dzaḥ yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas khro bo mtshon cha thogs pa mang po byung ste/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ phaṭa/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ /songs shig lha min lha yang rung / /nga la bar chad byed pa'i bdud/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par byos/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi dza ya hūm̐ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha nī la daṇ+ḍa hūm̐ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ār+ya a tsa la hūm̐ ban+dha ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṛ ba hūm̐ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a pa rā dzi ta hūm̐ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha tre lo kya bi dzā ya hūm̐ bhin+dha bhin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐ s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ khro bo rnams rang gi thugs khar thim/ yang rang gi thugs kha nas mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs byung ste sna bug nas 'thon/ g.yas nas bskor bas bgegs bskrad ste rwa bar gyur/ hūm̐ nga'i dkyil 'khor brtan bya'i phyir/ /khro rgyal byin rlabs las byung ba'i/ /mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /dkyil 'khor rim pa tshul bzhin srung / /oṃ badz+ra a yu dha rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang / rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rgyab sbyar mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel gung mdzub bskyangs pa'i phyag rgya bcas/ yang g.yon nas bskor te mtshon cha'i gur du gyur nas bgegs kyis mi tshugs par bsam la/ sngags kyi phyag rgya dang sngags la phaṭa bzhag bar gcod du med pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo shin tu brtan zhing gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar ba las mthe mdzub gnyis rtse sprad pa rin po che'i rnam par byas pa dang / srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas/ /dmyal ba'i sa gzhi yan chad kyi/ /log par blta ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ /'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs/ /oṃ badz+ra te dza tiṣ+ṭha tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang / rwa ba de dag las 'phros pa'i me 'od kyis bgegs thams cad bsreg par bsams shing / thal mo rgyab sbyar ba'i sor mo gzhan rnams bsnol/ de mthe bong rtse sprad pa dang / phyi rol kun tu 'od 'phros pas/ /bdud dpung nges par bsreg byed pa/ /sa dang mkha' kun khyab pa yi/ /'bar ba me yi phung por gyur/

/oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañja ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas/ he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor bla ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can bsrung ma dang bcas pa srung 'khor gyi nang mdun gyi nam mkha' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥshrī he ru ka maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa lan gsum gyi rgyun bshags bya/ mdun gyi tshogs kyi zhing de dag thams cad dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi thugs kha nas 'od 'phros pas/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs bsdus nas bdag dang dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ a la la hoḥhūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ hūm̐/ 'phags …dbyangs rgyas pa bzhin mchog thugs rje'i dus la bab/ /khyad par bstan pa'i dus la bab/ /mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la bab/ /byin gyis rlob pa'i dus la bab/ /dbang chen bskur ba'i dus la bab/ /dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab/ /mthu chen mthu stobs bcom ldan 'das/ /byin chen byin rlabs bcom ldan 'das/ /dbang chen dbang bskur bcom ldan 'das/ /dngos grub mchog stsol bcom ldan 'das/ /bdag gi las 'bras mchis par mdzod/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la la stsol/ /ces sogs rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas byin dbab bo/ /rdzas byin gyis rlabs pa ni/

oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ tas bsang / rang gi thugs kha nas raṃ dmar po spros pas mes bdud rtsi dang gtor ma'i snod la reg pas mi gtsang ba bsregs/ yaṃ spros pas rlung gis gtor/ khaṃ spros pas chus bkrus te skyon thams cad dag par byas/ bh+rūṃ spros pas ban+dha 'bar ba'i snod chen por gyur/ oṃ spros pas 'dod pa'i yon tan bsam gyi mi khyab pas gang bar gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs par hūm̐ oṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā las sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ rlung g.yos me sbar/ rdzas rnams 'od du zhu ba'i rlangs pa hūm̐ oṃ swā ā hā las phyag mtshan lngar gyur/ hūm̐ badz+ra dhṛka oṃ dzi na dzika swa rat+na dhṛka a a ro l̥ka hā pradz+nyā dh+rika he ru ka yab yum bcur gyur/ sa ma ya hoḥ sbyor ba'i mes 'od du zhu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ du gyur/ de las 'od 'phros pas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bdud rtsi bkug nas thim/ 'og gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres pas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ te dzo ba lin+ta ba la bā te gu h+ya sid+dhi sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ zhes bdun gyis byin gyis brlab/ rak+ta'i snod āḥlas thod pa yangs par ra las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ ra s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wā la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ zhes bdun gyis byin gyis brlab/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ dang po rang gi sems ma bcos pa stong pa nyid spros pa dang bral ba chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dang /

stong pa nyid des 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la khyab cing / de ltar ma rtogs pa rnams la rab tu brtse ba'i snying rje bsgom pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / thabs shes rab gnyis med rang rig gsal la ma 'gags pa de yi ge hūm̐ sngon po gcig tu gyur pa rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin te/ oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ hūm̐ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las raṃ chad snod bcud kyi 'jig rten bsregs/ yaṃ spros pas rlung gis gtor/ khaṃ spros pas chus bkrus/ skyon thams cad dag par byas/ e yaṃ baṃ raṃ laṃ raṃ keṃ bh+rūṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las yi ge de dag spros pas rten gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ e las …dbyangs rgyas pa bzhin mkha' dbyings dag pa nam mkha'i dkyil/ yaṃ las rlung chen rgya gram sra zhing brtan/ /de steng baṃ las byung ba'i chu dkyil dkar/ /raṃ las me byung bskyod pa de yis phyed/ /laṃ las sa yi dkyil 'khor brtan par gyur/ /de steng rak+ṣa'i rgya mtsho rba rlabs 'khrug /dbus su keng rus ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng / /bh+rūṃ las rin chen sna lnga'i rang bzhin las/ /legs grub dwangs shing thogs med gzhal yas khang / /phyogs bzhi shel gser byu ru margad mdog /lte ba bai ḍūr+ya yi rang bzhin can/ /steng logs rtsig pa ka ba gdung la sogs/ /kun kyang rin chen lnga las legs grub cing / /'khor lo rin chen pad ral rdo rjes mtshan/ /rgya phubs rtse mor rdo rje nor bu'i tog /sgo bzhi rin chen sna bzhi'i rang bzhin las/ rab mdzes rta babs bzhi yi rnam par brgyan/ /steng gi kha khyer rin chen du mas spras/ /bya 'dab las dpyangs gser gyi skud pas brgyus/ /rnga yab zla ba rdo rje phyed pa dang / /dar dpyangs sogs kyis brgyan pa'i do shal dang / /do shal phyed pas khor yug kun tu spras/

/steng du mda' yab pad+ma phyed pa'i dbyibs/ /thur du rin chen shar bus rnam par mdzes/ /'og gi stegs bur gzugs mas me long thogs/ /sgra mas gling bu dri mas dung chos thogs/ /ro chas zhal zas reg mas na bza' dang / /dbyings mas chos 'byung sgeg mos rdo rje dang / /phreng mas phreng ba glu mas pi wang bsnams/ /gar mas rdo rje me tog me tog snod/ /spos mas spos dang mar mes sgron me'i snod/ /rdza rnga rdza rnga chen mos rdza rngas mchod/ /gzhal yas dbus su bde chen byang chub sems/ /dkar dmar mdog can zla gam sgo gcig pa/ /dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du re re ste/ /phyi rol dur khrod phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu/ /shing me mchod rten chu bo grub pa brgyad/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin srin po dang / /sha za smyo byed brjed byed ro langs dang / /mdung dang gsal shing rtse yis phug pa'i ro/ /ro dum thod tshal sha khrag rus pas dkrigs/ /wa dang ce spyang khra 'ug bya rgod dang / /kaṃ ka la sogs phaiṃ sgra sgrogs pas gang / /dzaḥpa pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ /ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ a tsan+t+ra maṇ+ḍa la/ ma hā de ba dzaḥ u ma de bī dzaḥ ma trāṃ dzaḥ pad+ma/ nyi ma zla ba drag po pho mo'i gdan/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du pad+ma nyi ma ro'i gdan re re/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi hūm̐ sngon po de dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du babs pa las s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad he ru ka'i go 'phangs la bkod/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs bsdus nas hūm̐ la thim pas rang nyid he ru ka'i skur gyur pa ni/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ gtso bo'i spyan 'dren dbyangs gzur pa bzhin/……dbus su bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal/ /bcom ldan rdo rje he ru ka /mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rnga chung g.yas/

/dril bu thod khrag rgyu zhags g.yon/ /rdo rje'i khyung gshog rab tu gdengs/ /mche gtsigs spyan gsum zlum zhing dmar/ /ral pa kham pa gyen du brdzes/ /glang lpags zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol/ /stag gi lpags pa'i 'og pags can/ /dkar dmar ljang nag sbrul gyis brgyan/ /dbu rgyan se ral sked chings dang / /phyag dang zhabs rnams rnam par spras/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /rak+ta zhag dang thal chen gyi/ /thig le zo ris tshom bur byas/ /sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs nas/ /dbang phyug kha phub mgo bo dang / /dbu ma'i nu ma rab brdzis shing / /ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐/ yum chen khro mo dbang phyug sngo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stob/ /gzig gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ /rus pa'i rgyan lngas sku la spras/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas/ /sbrul dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /rak+ta zhag dang thal chen gyi/ /thig le zo ris tshom bur byas/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas g.yon brkyang bskum gyis/ /yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud pas bzhugs/ /dkar mo ba'i spyan 'dren gyi dbyangs 'jug……shar du gaṃ las gau rī sngo/ /g.yas na dbyug pa g.yon ban+dha/ /lho ru tsaṃ las tsau rī ser/ /phyag gnyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa'i tshul/ /nub tu praṃ las pra mo ha/ /dmar mo rgyal mtshan thod khrag 'dzin/ /byang du baṃ las bet+ta lī/ /ljang nag rdo rje byi ro za/ /shar lhor paṃ las puk+ka sī/ /dmar ser phyag gnyis rgyu zhags 'dren/ /srin por ghaṃ las ghasma rī/ /ljang gu rdo rje thod khrag 'dzin/ /rlung du shaṃ las dur khrod ma/ /mthing nag dpag bsam mi snying bsnams/ /byang shar tsaṃ las tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ /ser skya rtse gsum ro 'dzin pa/ /kun kyang dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/

/g.yon brkyangs me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /rang lus rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du gsal ba ni/ byang khog chos kyi 'byung gnas/ nang gi dbugs ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ lus kyi drod me/ chu ser dang sha lpags chu dang sa/ rtsa sbubs kyi khrag rak+ta'i rgya mtsho/ sgal tshigs keng rus kyi ri rab/ lus 'dom gang gru bzhi/ gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ snying kha nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa'i bu ga bzhi ni sgo bzhi/ tsit+ta gzhal yas khang zla gam/ srog pa rtsa sgo gcig pa/ snying tshil dkar dmar nyi zla'i gdan/ dbang po lnga mchod pa'i lha mo ste rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang / spyi gtsug tu badz+ra he ru ka sngon po/ 'tshogs mar bud+dha he ru ka dkar po/ rna ba g.yas par rat+na he ru ka ser po/ ltag par pad+ma he ru ka dmar po/ rna ba g.yon par karma he ru ka ljang gu rnams phyag g.yas rdo rje/ 'khor lo rin po che pad+ma/ rdo rje rgya gram rnams rim pas 'dzin cing / phyag g.yon pa rnams rang rang gi phyag mtshan gyi yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa dpral bar sku rdo rje dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ snying khar thugs rdo rje sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa rnams rang 'od kyi rig ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas la gau rī/ g.yon pa la pra mo ha/ phyag g.yas dang po tsau rī/ g.yon dang po bet+ta lī/ g.yos bar pa puk+ka sī/ tha ma sh+ma sha nī/ g.yon bar pa ghasma rī/ tha ma tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ sgal tshigs dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ snying kha'i dbus su ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra mtshon gang ba'i thugs khar rin po che zur brgyad pa'i lte bar rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyi lte ba la/ nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yungs 'bru tsam gyi tha mar ru lu skra shad kyis bris lta bus bskor ba/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/

rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor ……badz+ra sa mā dzaḥse gol gtogs spyan drangs par bsam la/ hūm̐ sems nyid ye shes skur gsal ba/ /spyan drangs gshegs pa mi mnga' yang / /ye shes sgyu ma'i ngang du gshegs/ /gnyis med sgyu ma'i ngang du thim/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka dz+nyā na gar+bha ma hā su kha saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas gnyis su med par thim/ gsal la mi 'gyur chos kyi sku/ /bsam med chos dbyings nam mkha' 'dra/ /brjod med rnam shes gzugs dang bral/ /'du 'bral med pa mkha' la rdzogs/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka dharmā dhā tu swa bhā wa ma hā su kha hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ rtogs med spros bral mkha' dbyings dag /skye med rdo rje sku gsung thugs/ /rang byung bcom ldan thugs rje'i lha/ /'du 'bral med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /a ti pa ho/ pra ti pa dzaḥ snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha khro bo rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ thabs kyi spyod pas sems can don/ /byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba/ /sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs par mdzod/ /dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig /ces gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ye shes kyi chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor he ru ka ……gser thal rigs lnga yab yum gyis dbu brgyan par bsam zhing / oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka badz+ra kro dhī shwa ri hūm̐/ oṃ bud+dha shrī he ru ka bud+dha kro dhī shwa ri oṃ/ oṃ rat+na shrī he ru ka rat+na dhī shwa ri trāṃ/ oṃ pad ma shrī he ru ka pad ma kro dhā shwa ri hrīḥ oṃ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro dhī shwa ri a/ zhes brjod/ de nas rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor mdun du spyan drangs par mos la/ hūm̐ḥ……mgon mthing ma'i dbyangs 'jug

bcom ldan dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum dang / /sprul pa yang sprul bka' stod bsrung ma'i tshogs/ /glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rjes 'dir gshegs nas/ /ye shes thugs rjes dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs nas/ rang gi snying kha nas sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis/ bdag dang mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la mchod par bsam zhing / sgeg phreng glu gar bdug pa me tog ma/ /mar me dri chab nyer spyod rol mo'i sgra/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor dam can bsrung ma la/ /rnam dag blo yis ma lus bdag 'bul na/ /bzhes shig bla med sgrub mchog stsal du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra lā s+ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra mā le traṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gīrti hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra nīrti a/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ badz+ra puṣ+pe traṃ/ badz+ra ā lo ke hrī/ badz+ra gen+dha a/ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ badz+ra ā lo ke hūm̐/ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐/ badz+ra nai wi d+yaṃ hūm̐/ badz+ra shap+ta hūm̐/ sman mchod ni/ rang ……gsor thal byung gdod nas dag pa yis/ /rtsa brgyad stong las sbyar ba'i sman/ /bzhes te kun tu dgyes mdzod la/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta shrī ka pā la ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ ces mchod la/ rang gi lce rtse smin mtshams/ mgrin pa/ snying kha rnams su thig le byas shing / byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung bsob pa'i/ /rigs 'dzin bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wāka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ rtog med spros bral mkha' dbyings dag /skye med sku gsung thugs mnga' ba/ /rang byung bcom ldan thugs rje'i lha/ /zhi khro rab 'byams 'khor dang bcas/ /stong nyid dbyings nas thugs dam bskul/

/sprul pa'i dbyings nas gshegs su gsol/ /dngos po'i mtshan mar bzung du med/ /rtog bral yid kyi mchod pa 'di/ /dgongs pa zab mo thugs dam bskang / /chos sku'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka a mṛ ta sarba pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gtor ma'i mchod pa ni/ rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma dang / /'dod pa'i yon tan rnams lnga po/ /chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i ngang / /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'bul/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka ma hā ba liṃ ta pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rak+ta'i mchod pa ni/ rak+ta dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ 'di/ /dam rdzas khrag chen chags pa yi/ /ma bcos dbyings su dag bya'i phyir/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung zhal du 'bul/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka kro dhī shwa ri satwaṃ/ ma hā rak+ta pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ces pas dbul/ de nas bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ḥ mgon po'i dad pa'i 'jug……bde gshegs mnyam nyid chos kyi ngang / /ma skyes rdo rje kun tu bzang / /thabs mkhas khro rgyal skur ston pa/ /he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ bdag nyid ma'i dbyangs 'jug……/rnam dag sku la chags mi mnga'/ /dgyes mdzad dpal chen sku la 'khril/ /shes rab gnyis med bde chen rdzogs/ /khro mo dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gsung mus chen gyi dbyangs 'jug……/me long mnyam nyid so sor rtog /bya sgrub ye shes rang bzhin dang / /'byung bzhi rnam par dag pa yi/ /lha mo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal chen 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol/ /khams gsum chos nyid dur khrod la/ /nyon mongs dug gsum thams cad ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor lo/ /tsit+ta mkha' mnyam rgyal po ni/ /kun gzhi ma bcos thig le la/ /rang byung ye shes sems dpa' bzhugs/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med/ /de nas zla gam dgu pa dang / /ye shes me dgu gcig tu gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa/ /'bras bu sku gsung thugs su shar/

/dpal chen ye shes skur gsal ba/ /thig le chen po ye shes sku/ /sems nyid ma bcos rang byung gi/ /'bras bu sangs rgyas thob par shog /ces pas bstod de/ de nas 'dzab bzlas pa ni/ snying kha'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs rang la thim par bsam zhing / hūm̐ dpal chen thugs kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /ye shes mtshon gang rin po che/ /thugs kyi snying po 'bru brgyad 'phros/ /'od zer gsal bar kun la khyab/ /oṃ ni 'bar ba'i seṅge brjid/ /ma tshogs sprin dang skar ltar 'phro/ /hūm̐ chen nyi zla'i tshogs rgyun 'dra/ /ma nor re skong mkha' la 'gro/ /oṃ ni ye shes lnga dang ldan/ /ru ni 'bar srog chags sdang 'joms/ /lu ni kun tu bzang bde ba'i yum/ /hūm̐ ni ye shes tshad med bzhi/ /bh+yo ni gnas gyur ma 'gags pa/ /hūm̐ gis byin rlabs sdud par byed/ /ru lu 'di ltar ya mtshan che/ /ru lu rtogs pa gong du 'phel/ /ru lu dngos grub ma lus ster/ /oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ zhes yab kyi snying po dang / oṃ badz+ra kro dhī shwa ri hūm̐/ zhes pas yum gyi snying po dang / oṃ badz+ra gau rī hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pra mo ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bet+ta lī hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra puk+ka sī hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sh+ma sha ne hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa lī hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas lha mo brgyad kyi snying po rnams ci nus bzla'o/ /bzlas pa bsdu ba na phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bcom ldan 'das dpal chen he ru ka'i go 'phangs tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ bsnyen tshad yab la 'bum phrag bcu/ yub la sogs pa rnams la bcu cha'o/

/gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga ni/ ci 'byor pa'i tshogs phyag chen bzhin bsham la nang mchod kyis sbyangs la/ oṃ dra byaṃ bi shwa dhā ni raṃ/ yaṃ/ khaṃ/ swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes byin gyis brlabs nas spyan drangs pa ni/ hūm̐/ zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs dang / /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /kun bzang mchod sprin tshogs 'bul gyi/ /gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs nas/ dang po mchod pa ni/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa 'di/ /ye shes lnga yis 'od zer 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis brgyan/ /thugs dam bzhin du bzhes su gsol/ /dam tshig bsgrub pa'i rdzas mchog 'di/ /bdag dang mnyam pa'i tshogs la 'bul/ /longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad ni/ /chos nyid ngang la chos nyid rol/ /a la la ho bzhes su gsol/ /rol du gsol/ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ zhes brjod cing tshogs phud gtor ma la phul/ bar pa bshags pa ni/ lus ngag yid kyi sdig pa rnams/ /gti mug dbang gis byas pa dag /'gyod pa'i sems dang bcas pa yi/ /lha tshogs khyed la mthol lo bshags/ /de nas tha ma bsgral ba'i mchod pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa'i mdun du/ liṅga phyag len bzhin bshams pa gu gul gyis bdugs nas bzhag de'i nye bar 'dug pa dang / ral gri yang 'dus byas shing rang nyid rdo rje dril bu snying khar 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgyas bzung la/ ngag tu/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi༞ chos kyi༞ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / 'jam dpal sku/ pad+ma gsung / yang dag thugs/ bdud rtsi yon tan/ phrin las phur pa/ ma mo sbod gtong / dmod pa drag sngags/ 'jig rten mchod bstod/ 'dus pa mdo/ sgyu 'phrul rgyan/ 'chi med tshe/ lhun grub rig 'dzin/ snying po phyag rgya/ gsang sngags rigs sngags gzungs sngags kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang /

bka' stod chos skyong / ma mo mkha' 'gro/ dam can rgya mtsho/ rigs 'dzin rnal 'byor/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa yang dag pa dang / bden pa chen pos byin gyis brlabs kyis/ spyir bstan pa'i spyi dgra/ bla ma'i sku dgra/ dam tshig can gyi sdang dgra/ sems can yongs la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa dang / khyad par du yang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gzugs can gyi dgra/ gzugs med kyi bgegs gang yin pa de dag thams cad skad cig thengs cig yud tsam la mtshan ma rdzas kyi liṅga 'di nyid la mchis par gyur cig oṃ raṃ ……rol mo chems brdungs dang dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐/ he he phaṭa/ kro dha da la maṇ+ḍa la phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod cing / dril bu sil/ sgo ba bzhi'i phyag rgyas bkug cing bstim pas liṅga de dgra bgegs dngos su bsam la/ de'i snying ……dgug zhugs mnan gsum byas pa'i tha ma la dmar nag gi mtshams su phur bus btab pas/ kho'i rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyes par bsgom/ kho'i tshe lhag rang la thim pas/ rang nyid tshe la dbang ba'i rigs 'dzin du gyur par bsam/ liṅga'i rnam smin gyi lus ral gris dum bur gtugs shing / oṃ gha gha/ ghā ta ya/ ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭan/ badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba sha trūn bi ghān mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing bsgral ba'i ling ro de 'dod yon lngar bsam nas/ lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du phul ba'i mos pa dang ldan pas/ bla ma ……phyi nang gsang ba'i dbyangs bskul nas 'jug la ni brnyas byed dang / /dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ /dam tshig gnyan po bral byed pa/ /gnod byed ma lus zhal du btab/ /badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha khā hi/ zhes brjod la ling ro gtor ma la phul bas lha thams cad mnyes te/ ha ha zhes gzhan/ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes bdag la dngos grub stsal/

phaṭa phaṭa kyis dgra bgegs chos nyid du gnas spar bar bsam/ de nas mchod g.yog pas tshogs khyer la/ ho bdag cag rdo rje slob dpon dang / /mched dang lcam dral ma lus pa/ /zhal zas tshogs la rol ba yis/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /a la la ho/ zhes brjod cing tshogs la rol/ de nas lhag ma rnams bsdus la/ lhag ma za ba'i bye brag pho nya/ phra men ma/ 'bar ba/ dbang phyug ma/ ma bdun sring bzhi la sogs pa pho nya sum brgya drug cu rnams blos 'gugs la mchod par bsam zhing / oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐/ oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ oṃ/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ traṃ/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hrī/ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ a/ ces pas gtso mo brgyad la gtor ma byin la/ oṃ u tsiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta bhak+ṣa si swāhā/ zhes brjod cing lhag ma la chang gi phru btab nas/ sarba ā na ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ta thā ya ta thā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas lhag ma btang zhing phyi rol du dor ro/ /de nas bstan pa skyong ba ni/ sgrub khang gi steng ngam/ gnas de nyid du/ rdo rje'i khyu gshog gi phyag rgya bcas la/ ho bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis/ dpal chen po'i phaṃ babs la mnos te rnal 'byor pa'i stong dang grogs la nag mo bzhin mi gdug gi bu mo bdun mo chen mo bzhi/ dmar mo khro gnyer can gyi bu mo gnod sbyin ma chen mo bzhi/ dkar bsham bzhin bzang gi bu mo sman btsun ma chen mo bzhi rnams sngon gyi thugs dam las ma 'da' bar 'dir gshegs shig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ḍā ki nī hūm̐ dzaḥ e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ zhes brjod cing 'jug la gong du bcas pa'i phyag rgyas sim gyis mnan te/ bh+yoḥbaka' yi bran g.yog tshogs dang bcas nyid du/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung de bzhin nam mkha'i sku/ /tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bstan ma skyong ba rnams/

/sngon gyi thugs dam dam tshig rjes dgongs te/ /'dir gshegs dam dgongs mchod sbyin gtor ma bzhes/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ /ces brjod nas sman raka dang / gtor ma rnams khang steng du phul la/ ya hi gats+tsha/ zhes pas bstan ma gshegs su gsol lo/ /de nas dngos grub blang ba ni/ ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga bde bar gshegs/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi/ /'khor lo rab bskor zhi khro'i skur ston pa/ /thugs dam dbang gis bdag la brtser dgongs nas/ /drag po'i stobs kyis dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang / /mchod dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang / med na gshegs gsol byas te/ bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu ni/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsol/ /bcad gtubs lus la mi 'byung zhing / /gzi mdangs nyi 'od bzhin du shog /oṃ badz+ra ka wa tse hūm̐/ ces pas bsrungs la/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ de dur khrod brgyad la thim/ de gzhal yas khang la thim/ de lha mo brgyad la thim/ de gtso bo yab yum la thim/ rang gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ dge ba 'di mtha' yas sems can kun/ /bdud las rnam rgyal bar chad kun bcom nas/ /khrag 'thung rgyal po he ru ka dpal gyi/ /'bras bu byang chub nges par 'grub gyur cig /bcas pas bsngo ba dang / smon lam gyis rgyas btab la/ shis pa brjod pa ni/ skye med chos sku'i rang bzhin rnam dag las/ /thugs dam dbang gi gzugs kyi skur sprul pa/ /bcom ldan dpal chen he ru ka dpal gyi/ /skye shi med pa don gyi bkra shis shog

/ma skyes mi dmigs chos kyi dbyings nyid las/ /cho 'phrul dngos po yum gyi skur sprul pa/ /khro mo dbang phyug lha mo brgyad po yi/ /yon tan 'byung ba don gyi bkra shis shog /gsang sngags rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i shes rab can/ /lta spyod yal bar ma gyur dgongs pa yis/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs spyod gzhung bsgrub pas/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing / /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa/ dkon mchog gsum gyi deng 'dir stsol/ /ces brjod la me tog gi char dbab cing rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya shing shis par bya'o/ /dpal yang dag par sbyor ba'i sgrub thabs rim pa gsal ba zhes bya ba 'di ni rje btsun dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan zhing / shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa thams cad kyi gnas tshul gsal bar gzigs pa'i ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa/ snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba mtha' yas pa'i gtsug gi nor bus nye bar bsten pa'i gnas/ phyi nang gi rig pa'i gnas rnams la legs par byang ba'i rnal dpyod 'gran zla med pa'i rgyal ba'i bka' dang / bstan bcos tshad mar gyur pa rnams rig pa'i lam gyis rang dbang du 'grel bar mdzad pa'i bdag nyid chen po sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i yang dag mar me gcig pa'i sgrub thabs gsal byed nor bu'i phreng ba dang / lha mo brgyad kyi bskyed chog phyag bris ma la gzhi byas/ tshig gi mtshams sbyor sogs cung zad dgos pa rnams bla ma gong ma'i phyag len gyis brgyan te/ bshes gnyen dam pa dkyil mchog bskul pa po rnam gsum gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ sa lo chen po de nyid kyis zhabs rdul spyi bos reg pa dang / snyoms las can gyi btsun pa sa skya pa ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos zil gnon zhes pa me pho rta'i lo la dben gnas dam pa byas 'gyur rdo rje'i brag rdzong du bris pa'i yi ge pa ni bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pa'i sngags 'chang ā nan+da dharma pā la'o/

/'dis rang dang skal pa mnyam pa'i blo dman rnams la phan pa rgya chen 'byung bar gyur cig 'khrul med sa skya'i rje btsun bstan gyur pa'i/ /zab lam rdo rje theg pa'i rnal 'byor mchog /ye shes me dgu'i nyams len la brten nas/ /mthar thugs he ru ka dpal mngon gyur shog/ //i dāṃ shā sa na/ sa thā hi to bha wan+tu/……sems can rnams bde bar gyur cig maṅgā laṃ/……bkra shis/ dharme u da ya mastu//……chos 'di dar bar gyur cig // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ mar me dgu pa'i sgrub thabs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
